# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old  <sub>[v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023), [v3 c28 P2](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired, attractive boy with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose, eyes dancing with elfish roguishness, and a perpetually smiling mouth featuring a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a sweet, amusing, uneven appearance when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Robin is highly mischievous, lively, inquisitive, and prone to endless playfulness. Though careless and easily driven to wicked pranks or impetuous rebellion, he possesses an affectionate heart, quickly feeling deep remorse when he realizes he has caused real grief. He displays an active curiosity about adult words, religious concepts, and formal rules, constantly questioning them.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)_

- To protect and defend his twin sister Lucy  <sub>[v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>

## History

After his mother passed away, Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy, their third cousin, at Grey Shutters. From the start of his stay, Robin caused relentless anxiety through wild antics, such as putting a toad in Thirza's bed and locking Lucy in a shop to pretend she was stolen. When confronted by Nell for lying about Lucy's disappearance, Robin expressed sincere sorrow, promising never to lie again. As time passed, he began attending school, where his misbehavior gradually decreased. After the death of his uncle Richard Farrow, a trust was left to support the twins' upbringing. During Nell's absences, Robin continuously confided his moral struggles, dark urges—such as wanting to try swearing—and confusion about religious doctrines to her. At age ten, he continued to live at Grey Shutters, frequently causing mischief alongside his schoolfriend Milty Gammon.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v3 c7 P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034), [v3 c13 P83](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0083), [v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)_

- His father died shortly after his birth  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Raised in neglected conditions by his sickly mother Mary Farrow until her death  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- Inherited interest from a two-thousand-dollar trust upon his uncle Richard Farrow's death  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
